records.source: Sets the cut between open wound and monolayer by hand, on the scale of the wound_level column of the wound table: for texture the local variance over the field's median, for intensity a share of the frame's 95th percentile. Use it when the automatic cut misreads a series: run once, read wound_level, then set a value. Higher counts more of the field as open. Used on every frame, with no recalibration of later frames. Blank or 0 keeps the automatic cut. Ignored by the masks source. Default None.
records.translation: 手动设定开放伤口与单层之间的分界，所用尺度与伤口表中 wound_level 列相同：纹理为局部方差除以视野中位数，强度为该帧第 95 百分位数的一个比例。当自动分界误读某个序列时使用：先运行一次，读取 wound_level，再设定一个值。数值越高，视野中被计为开放的部分越多。用于每一帧，后续帧不再重新校准。留空或 0 则保留自动分界。masks 来源会忽略此项。默认值 None。
